items.question: How does LINE perform on a directed graph dataset compared with DeepWalk in terms of Micro-F1 or another downstream classification metric?

items.question: Under which exact conditions does LINE switch from using the first-order proximity objective to the second-order proximity objective, and how many training epochs are used for each objective?
